fields.name: height_left
fields.label: Height left (raw)
fields.description: Left ride-height sensor (raw 0–255, ≈1.4 mm per count). Typical ~135–165; calibration-dependent.

fields.name: height_right
fields.label: Height right (raw)
fields.description: Right ride-height sensor (raw 0–255, ≈1.4 mm per count). Typical ~135–165; calibration-dependent.

fields.name: any_door
fields.label: Door open
fields.description: Any door open. SLABS won't adjust suspension with a door open. Normal: closed.

fields.name: battery
fields.label: Battery
fields.description: System voltage. 13.8–14.4 V running; below 13 = charging fault.

fields.name: ecu_supply
fields.label: ECU supply
fields.description: Internal SLABS ECU supply voltage.

fields.name: wheel_speed_fl
fields.label: Wheel speed FL
fields.description: Front-left wheel speed (raw ~124 stationary). ⚠ Wheel order unconfirmed.

fields.name: wheel_speed_fr
fields.label: Wheel speed FR
fields.description: Front-right wheel speed (raw ~124 stationary). ⚠ Wheel order unconfirmed.

fields.name: wheel_speed_rl
fields.label: Wheel speed RL
fields.description: Rear-left wheel speed. ⚠ Wheel order unconfirmed.

fields.name: wheel_speed_rr
fields.label: Wheel speed RR
fields.description: Rear-right wheel speed. ⚠ Wheel order unconfirmed.

fields.name: abs_sensor_fl
fields.label: ABS sensor FL
fields.description: Front-left ABS sensor voltage (~2.3 V). ⚠ Order unconfirmed.

fields.name: abs_sensor_fr
fields.label: ABS sensor FR
fields.description: Front-right ABS sensor voltage (~2.3 V). ⚠ Order unconfirmed.

fields.name: abs_sensor_rl
fields.label: ABS sensor RL
fields.description: Rear-left ABS sensor voltage. ⚠ Order unconfirmed.

fields.name: abs_sensor_rr
fields.label: ABS sensor RR
fields.description: Rear-right ABS sensor voltage. ⚠ Order unconfirmed.

fields.name: reverse_gear
fields.label: Reverse gear
fields.description: Reverse gear selected (automatic gearbox selector).

fields.name: neutral_gear
fields.label: Neutral gear
fields.description: Neutral selected (automatic gearbox selector). Park also reads 0 here.

fields.name: diff_lock
fields.label: Centre diff lock
fields.description: Centre differential lock engaged.

fields.name: transfer_low
fields.label: Transfer box low range
fields.description: Set when the transfer box is in low range.

fields.name: brake_analog
fields.label: Brake signal (raw)
fields.description: Analogue brake-pedal signal on SLABS 21 48 (raw u16; falls when the pedal is pressed). Candidate, unscaled.

fields.name: height_left_mm
fields.label: Height left
fields.description: Left ride height in mm (derived from the raw sensor).

fields.name: height_right_mm
fields.label: Height right
fields.description: Right ride height in mm (derived from the raw sensor).
